chunks.arabic_text: اَلْكَافِي: عَلِيٌّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَجَّاجِ قَالَ

translations.en: Al-Kafi: Ali, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj who said:

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: إِياكَ وَخَصْلَتَيْنِ، فَفِيهِمَا هَلَكَ مَنْ هَلَكَ: إِياكَ أَنْ تَفْتِيَ النَّاسَ بِرَأْيِكَ أَوْ تَدِينَ بِمَا لَا تَعْلَمُ

translations.en: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: Beware of two qualities, for in them are destroyed those who are destroyed: Beware of giving fatwa to the people based on your own opinion, or of taking as part of your religion that which you do not know.

en.summary: Imam Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) warns against two specific pitfalls that lead to spiritual ruin: issuing religious rulings based merely on personal opinion rather than established knowledge, and adopting into one's religion matters about which one lacks certainty or knowledge.
en.seo_question: What are the two qualities that lead to destruction according to Imam al-Sadiq?

key_terms.تَدِينَ: take as part of your religion
